request: Rename the `watched` field of watchlist items to `seen` everywhere.

requests.title: Watchlist > navigates via the title link without toggling watched
requests.reason: This test reads the watchlist item field `store.items()[0].watched` in its final assertion. `WatchItem` now exposes `seen: boolean` instead of `watched: boolean`, so the read was renamed to `store.items()[0].seen`. No other part of the test (assertion value, name, or behaviour) was changed; this is the expected-field-rename path described in the instruction.
